title: SetupFallbackPipelineContract
description: JSON Schema contract for setup.sh 4-tier wheel detection and fallback verification

tier_level.description: Tier 1: CLI wheel-path, Tier 2: venv cache, Tier 3: Seed pack bundle wheel, Tier 4: C++ Source compile

wheel_path.description: Path to the detected or compiled wheel file

installed_via_fast_track.description: True if installed via prebuilt wheel without source compilation

symlinks_created.description: List of created root symlinks: start_server.sh, stop_server.sh, status_server.sh
